comments.body: 2026-11-13: measured on Codex 0.167.2 (corpus/codex-0.167.2/session-names.txt, session-name-metadata.json, observation section 9). Hooks carry no name and no rename event; the only source that tells an explicit rename from an automatic title is Codex's private state_5.sqlite (threads.name). Needs the owner's decision on whether Muster reads that.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Pane-to-session naming works for Codex (/rename typed at an idle prompt). The other direction is not built: Codex names every session itself after its first turn, writing session_index.jsonl the same way a person's /rename does, so its own names cannot be told apart from a person's (corpus/codex-0.154.0/rename.txt). Maybe Codex's app-server or thread_name metadata distinguishes them; unmeasured.
title: Codex: a pane named after its session
